node.title: Conjecture-F prize consumer flat-scope compiler
node.statement: The current strict DAG has exactly two Conjecture-F callers, imgfib and spi_point_counting. Conditional on an exhaustive LIST-side branch-to-flat compiler, combine it with the proved Hankel slope-fiber descriptor and emit exact multiplicity-preserving descriptors with domain, locator degree j, projective dimension r, root threshold, punctures, and first-owner chronology. The full Pade section is polynomial rather than linear; only an explicitly extracted projective cell may be sent to Conjecture F.
node.attack_surface: close the LIST branch-to-flat inventory, keep the strict-caller guard pinned, and print the quantitative dimension gap and first-owner transport
node.falsifier: an omitted strict caller or LIST branch, a Pade polynomial section mislabeled linear, a near-full-dimensional unowned descriptor outside the packing regime, or multiplicity/owner loss
